    AI Overview
    PayPal is a widely used international online payment system that allows users to send and receive money securely. 
    • It was founded in 1998 and has become a popular method for making cashless payments and money transfers over the internet. 
    • Users can link their credit cards, debit cards, or bank accounts to their PayPal account for seamless transactions. 
    • The service can be used for online shopping, transferring funds, and managing finances. 
    • While PayPal does not offer resident Pakistanis the ability to hold a PayPal wallet, they can receive money through Xoom, which is a PayPal service, directly into a bank account or by picking up a cash transfer at a local bank.
